description: She wears an opaque purple floor-length gown with a low square neckline, fitted bodice, elbow-length sleeves and a full skirt. Gold-toned woven floral-geometric borders decorate the neckline, sleeves, vertical front and hem. A cream underdress appears through the modest opening below the knee. A cream textured wrap with purple-and-gold woven bands hangs from both forearms. A narrow gold-toned belt closes at paired round decorated clasps. Drop earrings, a broad bracelet and a small dark-stone finger ring are visible. Dark leather shoe toes have gold-toned patterned decoration. No headgear or weapon is visible.
